notes: No power pin or shared rail clamp; no VBUS-to-data-source path through this device.
Use one device for DP/DM and one for CC1/CC2.
5.5V standoff is not a CC/VBUS short-to-high-voltage OVP guarantee.
USB branch only; bench 1.07A mode bypasses this branch.
Current authorization and USB suspend still require firmware.
Temperature, board copper, fault duration, and inrush need actual validation.
Rated surge point is not measured board clamping.
Sustained wrong voltage is not covered by this TVS/PTC candidate.
Leakage bypasses BQ input current measurement and belongs to whole USB input budget.
AOS uses a cathode band; no numeric package pin is assigned by its datasheet. KiCad uses 1=K,2=A.

network.selector_note: Exactly one 2-pin shunt;1-2 USB,2-3 BENCH,removed input disconnect; do not change live.
network.cc: A5=CC1,B5=CC2; independent 5.1k 1% to GND; no PD/source/Rp mode.
network.protection: USB_VBUS -> PTC -> USB_5V_PROTECTED; TVS from protected rail to GND; no bench-to-USB power parallel path through selector.
network.sense: R221/Q201 detector -> USB_5V_PROTECTED, after PTC and before selector. Low means USB branch voltage available. PTC open/fault may suppress insertion indication; BENCH must not look like USB.
network.bench: Existing J101 only; 5V regulated, current-limited known bench source. Bench branch bypasses USB PTC/TVS; no reverse-polarity or arbitrary source guarantee.

layout: 22ohm series and DNP shunt C close to MCU, per Espressif.
Data ESD devices near connector, short ground return; DP/DM 90ohm +/-10% differential, continuous reference plane, minimal vias.
Merge A/B copies at USB receptacle; avoid long stubs.
Input visible capacitance: nominal 0.1uF + existing4.7uF, plus parasitics and tolerance; validate USB inrush (no claim of compliance).
review_notes: USBLC6-2SC6 connected directly to 5.5V Type-C VBUS was not selected because its published VRWM is 5.25V.
C503 is before PTC; actual USB ESD clamping/loop inductance and input inrush are layout/measurement tasks; no blanket board qualification claim.
